title: feat: introduce controlled mode

comments.body: A "forceUpdate" would look like this right: `setUiState(state => state)`. I don't think we need a different paradigm for it, but just wanted to mention it. Since all helper methods send a change event I don't think there's a use case though.
I looked, and couldn't find an eslint rule to prefer types over interfaces, or the other way round :(
@Haroenv  were you looking for something like this? https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/blob/master/packages/eslint-plugin/docs/rules/consistent-type-definitions.md
